lede: A filing posted Aug. 5 for Interior Secretary Douglas J. Burgum discloses six trades dating from April 8, all executed through Arthur Ventures funds. The largest was a purchase of Nucleus Security, Inc. valued at up to $250,000, alongside smaller purchases and sales ranging from $1,001 to $15,000. Across the 153 transactions Open Cabinet tracks for Burgum, 106 have been flagged as filed late, meaning the filer certified that notification came more than 30 days before filing.
